title: OLS Projection
text: OLS predictions are the projection of Y onto the column space of X. This means $$\hat{Y}$$ is in col(X), and the residual $$r$$ $$=$$ Y - $$\hat{Y}$$ is orthogonal to col(X).

title: Decompose Y
text: Write Y $$=$$ $$\hat{Y}$$ + $$r$$. Since $$\hat{Y}$$ lies in col(X), and $$r$$ is orthogonal to col(X), $$r$$ is orthogonal to $$\hat{Y}$$.

title: Dot Product Check
text: Using Y $$=$$ $$\hat{Y}$$ + $$r$$ and $$r$$ orthogonal to $$\hat{Y}$$, $$what$$ $$is$$ $$Y$$ $$dot$$ $$\hat{Y}$$ equal to?

title: Rule Out Both Simple Relationships
text: Since Y dot $$\hat{Y}$$ equals $$\lVert\hat{Y}\rVert**2$$ in general, Y is not guaranteed to be orthogonal to $$\hat{Y}$$. $$Since$$ $$Y$$ $$may$$ $$also$$ $$include$$ $$a$$ $$residual$$ $$component$$ $$outside$$ $$span(\$\$\hat{Y}\$\$)$$, $$Y$$ $$is$$ $$not$$ $$guaranteed$$ $$to$$ $$be$$ $$in$$ $$the$$ $$span$$ $$of$$ $$\hat{Y}$$ either.
